name: Sweden
regulation: Boverket's building regulations (BFS 2024:8 hygiene and health, BFS 2024:9 safety in use)
scope_note: Sweden's new rules are functional: they set no riser, going, stair width, handrail height, ceiling height, window or openable ratio (daylight is a daylight factor of 1.0 %, ventilation 0.35 l/s per m²), so only stair headroom is checked.

stair.headroom.min.note: Clear height in stairs and circulation spaces.

name: Germany
scope_note: The national model: each Land's building code (LBO) broadly follows it. Stair values are DIN 18065 (from secondary sources; the standard is paywalled) for buildings with up to two dwellings and inside dwellings, and are not building law for houses in building classes 1 and 2; the ceiling rule does not apply to residential building classes 1 and 2 either.

stair.riser.max.note: Up to two dwellings / inside dwellings; 190 mm in other buildings. Stride rule 2s + a = 590-650 mm.

stair.tread.min.note: Required stairs, up to two dwellings / inside dwellings; 260 mm in other buildings.

stair.width.min.note: Usable width, up to two dwellings / inside dwellings; 1000 mm in other buildings.

room.ceiling.min.note: Attic rooms 2.20 m over half the floor area. Does not apply to residential buildings of building classes 1 and 2.

room.light.min.note: Window openings (structural size) at least 1/8 of the net floor area.

name: Brazil
regulation: ABNT standards NBR 9077 (exits), NBR 9050 (accessibility), NBR 15575 (housing performance)
authority: ABNT; municipal Códigos de Obras; state fire brigades
scope_note: Brazil has no national building code: ABNT standards apply nationally and municipal codes set room sizes and openings. Values from a 2001 NBR 9077 copy and secondary sources; current editions not confirmed. Width (1.10 m) is the emergency-exit rule and is not checked for houses.

stair.rail.height.note: NBR 9050 accessible routes: double handrails at 700 and 920 mm.

room.ceiling.min.note: 2.30 m allowed in halls, corridors, toilets and bathrooms. Municipal codes may require more.
